name: xsdValidator
description: Validates the XML request body against an XSD fetched from a configurable xsdURL. Unlike the stock xmlValidator policy, this exposes xsdURL as a parameter and turns schemaValidation on, so the gateway XMLSchemaValidator mediator fetches the given XSD (and any nested import/include/DTD) through the network access-control SSRF gate.

policyAttributes.name: xsdURL
policyAttributes.description: URL of the XSD to validate the request body against (the SSRF gate is applied to this URL and to any nested import/include/DTD inside it).
